create_job.name: Create job
create_job.description: Adds a cleaning job to the end of the queue. Values you leave out come from the job defaults.

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: Home Assistant areas to clean, in this order. VOI room IDs are accepted as well.

rooms.name: Rooms without area
rooms.description: VOI room IDs of rooms that have no Home Assistant area.

all_rooms.name: All rooms
all_rooms.description: Cleans every active room instead of the named areas and rooms.

mode.name: Cleaning mode
mode.description: Vacuum, mop, both together, or vacuum first and then mop.

vacuum_power.name: Vacuum power
vacuum_power.description: Requested suction level; each robot uses the nearest level it offers unless the settings policy is strict.

mop_intensity.name: Water amount
mop_intensity.description: Requested amount of water for mopping.

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: How often the robot cleans each room, 1 to 10.

reason.name: Occasion
reason.description: Optional occasion of the job, for example a visit.

dedupe_key.name: Deduplication key
dedupe_key.description: Rejects the job while another waiting job has the same key.

required_on.name: Must be on
required_on.description: Entities that must be on before the job may start, for example an open door contact.

required_off.name: Must be off
required_off.description: Entities that must be off before the job may start.

settings_policy.name: Settings policy
settings_policy.description: Best effort uses the nearest setting a robot offers; strict starts only on a robot that offers every requested value.

start.name: Start now
start.description: Creates and starts the job in one step. If it cannot start now, nothing is created.

robot_id.name: Robot
robot_id.description: Only with Start now; otherwise VOI chooses the robot. The robot's vacuum entity or robot ID.

job_id.description: ID of the job, from get_queue or the response of create_job.

job_id.description: ID of the job, from get_queue or the response of create_job.

hold_id.description: Only for the dashboard card, which passes the token of its edit or delete protection. Automations leave it empty.

move_job.name: Move job
move_job.description: Moves a waiting job up, down, to the top or to the bottom of the queue.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: ID of the job, from get_queue or the response of create_job.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Where the job moves in the queue.

start_job.name: Start job
start_job.description: Starts a waiting job now, on the best robot or on the robot you choose.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: ID of the job, from get_queue or the response of create_job.

robot_id.name: Robot
robot_id.description: Optional; otherwise VOI chooses the robot. The robot's vacuum entity or robot ID.

run_queue.name: Run queue
run_queue.description: Starts processing the queue: waiting jobs start as soon as they can.

pause_queue.name: Pause queue
pause_queue.description: Starts no new jobs; started jobs continue.

end_queue.name: End queue run
end_queue.description: Ends the current queue run; waiting jobs stay in the queue. Started jobs either finish first or are cancelled.

running_jobs.name: Started jobs
running_jobs.description: Finish lets started jobs complete, including a pending mopping phase, and then closes the run without a grace period; cancel stops them and closes the run now.

after_cancel.name: After cancelling
after_cancel.description: Whether a stopped robot stays where it is or returns to its dock.

cancel_job.name: Cancel job
cancel_job.description: Cancels a waiting job or safely stops a running one. With return to dock, the cancel completes once the robot rests at its dock.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: ID of the job, from get_queue or the response of create_job.

after_cancel.name: After cancelling
after_cancel.description: Whether a stopped robot stays where it is or returns to its dock.

return_robot.name: Return robot to dock
return_robot.description: Sends a robot without a running job back to its dock.

robot_id.name: Robot
robot_id.description: The robot's vacuum entity or robot ID.

retry_job.name: Retry job
retry_job.description: Adds a new job with the rooms and settings of a finished job to the queue.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: ID of the job, from get_queue or the response of create_job.

correct_job.name: Correct job outcome
correct_job.description: Records whether a finished job cleaned its rooms; the rooms' due times follow.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: ID of the job, from get_queue or the response of create_job.

outcome.name: Outcome
outcome.description: Completed records the job's rooms as cleaned; failed removes the cleanings the job recorded.

get_queue.name: Get queue
get_queue.description: Returns a page of the waiting jobs and the state of the queue.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of entries, at most 100.

get_job.name: Get job
get_job.description: Returns one job with its state, rooms and settings.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: ID of the job, from get_queue or the response of create_job.

configure_queue.name: Configure queue
configure_queue.description: Sets the grace period of future queue runs and the start delay of new and edited jobs; give at least one.

grace_seconds.name: Grace period
grace_seconds.description: How long a queue run without work stays open, at most one day. Blocked waiting jobs do not keep it open.

start_delay_seconds.name: Start delay
start_delay_seconds.description: How long the queue waits before it starts a job that was just added or edited, at most 10 minutes. Starting a job directly skips the delay.

configure_job_defaults.name: Configure job defaults
configure_job_defaults.description: Sets the values new jobs get when they name none; existing jobs keep theirs.

mode.name: Cleaning mode
mode.description: Cleaning mode of new jobs that name none.

vacuum_power.name: Vacuum power
vacuum_power.description: Suction level of new jobs that name none.

mop_intensity.name: Water amount
mop_intensity.description: Water amount of new jobs that name none.

mop_route.description: Mop route of new jobs that name none.

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: Passes of new jobs that name none, 1 to 10.

settings_policy.name: Settings policy
settings_policy.description: Settings policy of new jobs that name none.

create_room.description: Creates a room; it starts locked.

area_id.description: Optional Home Assistant area of the room.

update_room.name: Update room
update_room.description: Changes a room's name, area, robot bindings, conditions or due policy. The cleaning history stays unchanged.

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: ID of the room from get_rooms; the ID of its Home Assistant area is accepted as well.

configuration.name: Configuration
configuration.description: Fields to change: name, area_id, floor_id, enabled, follow_area_name, bindings, requirements or due_policy.

disable_room.name: Disable room
disable_room.description: Excludes a room from new jobs; its history stays and it is not imported again.

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: ID of the room from get_rooms; the ID of its Home Assistant area is accepted as well.

enable_room.name: Enable room
enable_room.description: Makes a disabled room available for new jobs again.

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: ID of the room from get_rooms; the ID of its Home Assistant area is accepted as well.

release_room.name: Release rooms
release_room.description: Allows jobs to start in the rooms: until revoked, for the next job, for a duration or for the queue run.

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: Home Assistant areas of the rooms. VOI room IDs are accepted as well.

rooms.name: Rooms without area
rooms.description: VOI room IDs of rooms that have no Home Assistant area.

kind.name: Release type
kind.description: How long the release lasts; the same for all named rooms.

duration_seconds.name: Duration
duration_seconds.description: Only for a release for a duration.

revoke_room.name: Lock rooms
revoke_room.description: Stops new jobs from starting in the rooms; started jobs may finish all their phases.

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: Home Assistant areas of the rooms. VOI room IDs are accepted as well.

rooms.name: Rooms without area
rooms.description: VOI room IDs of rooms that have no Home Assistant area.

add_robot.name: Add robot
add_robot.description: Adds a vacuum as a robot with the defaults of automatic discovery; change details with Configure robot.

entity_id.name: Vacuum
entity_id.description: The vacuum entity of the robot.

name.name: Name
name.description: Optional; without a name the robot follows the name of its vacuum in Home Assistant.

configure_robot.name: Configure robot
configure_robot.description: Changes the profile of an idle robot: roles, targets, conditions and supported settings.

robot_id.name: Robot
robot_id.description: The robot's vacuum entity or robot ID.

configuration.name: Configuration
configuration.description: Profile fields to change, for example fixed_mode, minimum_battery, roles or target_areas.

remove_robot.name: Remove robot
remove_robot.description: Removes an idle robot; automatic discovery does not add it again.

robot_id.name: Robot
robot_id.description: The robot's vacuum entity or robot ID.

rename_robot.name: Rename robot
rename_robot.description: Gives a robot its own name, or lets it follow the name of its vacuum in Home Assistant again.

robot_id.name: Robot
robot_id.description: The robot's vacuum entity or robot ID.

name.name: Name
name.description: Leave empty to follow the name of the vacuum in Home Assistant again.

resolve_recovery.name: Free robot
resolve_recovery.description: Gives up the uncertain work of a robot once it has stopped. Confirming the stop also frees a removed robot. Never records a cleaning as successful.

robot_id.name: Robot
robot_id.description: The robot's vacuum entity or robot ID.

confirm_stopped.name: I verified that the robot is stopped
confirm_stopped.description: Confirms a physical stop, also for a removed robot. Without it, VOI must observe the stop itself.

save_template.name: Save template
save_template.description: Creates or replaces a reusable job. An automatic template creates at most one job per room and due period.

template_id.name: Template ID
template_id.description: Leave empty to create a template; with an ID, that template is replaced.

intent.name: Job
intent.description: Fields of create_job without start and robot, for example areas and mode.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: A disabled template creates no automatic jobs.

automatic.name: Create jobs when due
automatic.description: Creates a job when one of its rooms becomes due.

save_job_as_template.name: Save job as template
save_job_as_template.description: Stores a job's rooms, settings, title and note as a new enabled template; occasion and deduplication key are not copied.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: ID of the job, from get_queue or the response of create_job.

automatic.name: Create jobs when due
automatic.description: Creates a job when one of its rooms becomes due.

remove_template.name: Remove template
remove_template.description: Removes a template; jobs created from it stay.

template_id.name: Template ID
template_id.description: ID of the template from get_templates.

create_job_from_template.name: Create job from template
create_job_from_template.description: Adds an independent copy of the template to the queue.

template_id.name: Template ID
template_id.description: ID of the template from get_templates.

reset_template_demand.name: Reset template demand
reset_template_demand.description: Lets an automatic template create a job again for due rooms whose job failed or was cancelled. Does not start the queue.

template_id.name: Template ID
template_id.description: ID of the template from get_templates.

get_rooms.name: Get rooms
get_rooms.description: Returns a page of rooms with release, due and reach information.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of entries, at most 100.

get_robots.name: Get robots
get_robots.description: Returns a page of robots with configuration, capabilities and state.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of entries, at most 100.

get_robot_candidates.name: Get robot candidates
get_robot_candidates.description: Returns the registered vacuums with their detected roles.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of entries, at most 100.

get_templates.name: Get templates
get_templates.description: Returns a page of templates and their automatic demand.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of entries, at most 100.

get_history.name: Get history
get_history.description: Returns a page of recorded cleaning runs and how well their success is proven.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of entries, at most 100.

get_room.name: Get room
get_room.description: Returns one room with bindings, conditions, release and cleaning evidence.

room_id.name: Room ID
room_id.description: ID of the room from get_rooms; the ID of its Home Assistant area is accepted as well.

validate.name: Validate input
validate.description: Checks the input of a command without applying it and returns every field error with its path.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command whose input is checked.

data.name: Data
data.description: The input as the command expects it.

get_trace.name: Get trace
get_trace.description: Returns recent diagnostic events and stored incidents.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of entries, at most 100.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: Optional; only events and incidents of this job.

get_diagnostics.name: Get diagnostics
get_diagnostics.description: Returns a bounded, anonymized diagnostic export.

get_setup.name: Get setup
get_setup.description: Returns the facts of each setup assistant step and whether setup was finished.

get_job_execution.name: Explain job execution
get_job_execution.description: Explains per robot and operation what blocks a job, which settings it would get, and its attempts so far.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: ID of the job, from get_queue or the response of create_job.

preview_job.name: Preview job
preview_job.description: Evaluates a job draft without creating it: the offered settings, the values to preselect and whether it could start now.

areas.name: Areas
areas.description: Home Assistant areas to clean, in this order. VOI room IDs are accepted as well.

rooms.name: Rooms without area
rooms.description: VOI room IDs of rooms that have no Home Assistant area.

all_rooms.name: All rooms
all_rooms.description: Cleans every active room instead of the named areas and rooms.

mode.name: Cleaning mode
mode.description: Vacuum, mop, both together, or vacuum first and then mop.

vacuum_power.name: Vacuum power
vacuum_power.description: Requested suction level; each robot uses the nearest level it offers unless the settings policy is strict.

mop_intensity.name: Water amount
mop_intensity.description: Requested amount of water for mopping.

passes.name: Passes
passes.description: How often the robot cleans each room, 1 to 10.

settings_policy.name: Settings policy
settings_policy.description: Best effort uses the nearest setting a robot offers; strict starts only on a robot that offers every requested value.

required_on.name: Must be on
required_on.description: Entities that must be on before the job may start, for example an open door contact.

required_off.name: Must be off
required_off.description: Entities that must be off before the job may start.

robot_id.name: Robot
robot_id.description: Optional; checks the start on this robot. The robot's vacuum entity or robot ID.
